about: Rewrite cases for atlas-prompt. `gold` is the human-written list of goals and constraints in the original; a faithful rewrite keeps every one. `skip` marks inputs the skill must answer with SKIP. `size` is the expected weight of the rewrite (simple or complex). Cases marked real come from the owner's own requests, quoted as sent.

Add a --json flag to the status command.
rename getUser to fetchUser everywhere except the public API in src/api/v1
gold: apply the rename everywhere else in the codebase
